# Vendor marks

`qwen.svg`, `openai.svg`, `gemini.svg` and `doubao.svg` come from the npm package
[`@lobehub/icons-static-svg`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lobehub/icons-static-svg)
version 1.100.0 (files `icons/qwen-color.svg`, `icons/openai.svg`, `icons/gemini-color.svg`,
`icons/doubao-color.svg`), whose `package.json` declares the MIT license. Only the fixed
`width`/`height`/`style` attributes were removed so the images size from CSS.

The marks themselves are trademarks of their owners (Alibaba Cloud, OpenAI, Google,
ByteDance). ReaLingo shows them only to identify which service an interface connects to.
